title: ChemInform Abstract: Electrophilic Substitution Reaction of Indole. Part 24. Synthesis, Characterization, and Crystal Structure of a Novel Heterocyclic Compound.
abstract: AbstractThe reaction of indole (I) with cyclohexanone (II) in the presence of boron trifluoride etherate results in the formation of the novel spiro compound (III) together with the known compound (IV).
